title: Separated Signal Libraries: Packing, Saturation, and Joint Spectral Limits
abstract: arXiv:2609.17609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study libraries of cross-sectional signals: at each date, a forecast vector over $d$ assets intended to predict the next period's cross-sectional return. Demeaned and unit-normalized, a signal is a point on a sphere and its $T$-date history a point on a product of $T$ spheres. A pairwise correlation cap on histories is a minimum angular separation on that product, so growing a library under such a cap is a packing problem. If a large library is not too pairwise correlated and is equally weighted, does the equally weighted sum (EWS) tend to a known principal-component quantity as it grows? We answer this under explicit assumptions on how the library is filled. translated_title: 分离信号库：填充、饱和与联合谱极限
translated_abstract: 我们研究截面信号库：在每一日期，一个针对 $d$ 个资产的预测向量，用于预测下一期的截面收益率。经过去均值和单位归一化后，一个信号是球面上的一个点，其 $T$ 日历史是 $T$ 个球面乘积空间上的一个点。历史序列的两两相关性上限等价于该乘积空间上的最小角间隔，因此在此约束下扩展信号库是一个填充问题。如果一个大型信号库的两两相关性不太高且采用等权方式，那么等权和（EWS）是否会随其增长而趋于某个已知的主成分量？我们在关于信号库如何填充的明确假设下回答了这一问题。仅有分离性并不能保证任何结论：它无法确定极限分布；一个饱和的信号库虽然覆盖了球面，却可能带有有偏的计数；而在固定区域上的近最大填充会迫使体积均匀，这在无约束球面上意味着均值为零且不存在突出的主方向……
tldr: 该论文将截面信号库的构建几何化为球面乘积空间上的填充问题，证明了信号间的低相关性（分离性）本身不足以保证等权和收敛于已知主成分量，并在信号库填充方式的明确假设下给出了联合谱极限的结果。
en_tdlr: This paper frames the construction of cross-sectional signal libraries as a packing problem on a product of spheres, showing that pairwise separation alone guarantees nothing about limiting distributions, and derives joint spectral limits for equally weighted sums under explicit assumptions on how libraries are filled.
